item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. It will be able to produce the goods, services and discoveries humanity needs. Work will become a choice—not a condition of survival.

2. We believe superintelligent AI will end compulsory work. Once intelligence beyond our own can perform every economic task, no one will need a job to secure food, housing, healthcare or dignity.

3. Superintelligent AI means freedom from required labor. If we build it within the next 20 years, humanity can leave behind the idea that people must sell their time to survive. No human will ever need to work again.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 105 words

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. A system more capable than any person at every economically valuable task will be able to generate the goods, services, knowledge and abundance our societies require. That transformation will end work as a condition of survival. People may still choose to create, build, teach, care, explore or pursue ambitious projects—but no one will need a job to secure food, housing, healthcare or dignity. We should prepare now for that future, ensuring the abundance created by superintelligent AI belongs to everyone and frees all humanity.
